subject: info-doc
title: (R)INFO.DOC.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 296 (CMOA(II)-54). INFO-DOC (information documentation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-COMP (information compression), AFL (affinity alignment) and SOC-RT (social reality). From INFO-COMP: IST-F (isolated focus). From AFL: EXT-DY (extended dynamics). From EXT-DY: MT-INFO-DB and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From SOC-RT: IST-ACT (isolated activism), POL-DY (political dynamics) and PHY-U-C (physical universe context). From POL-DY: APP-DEF.
